summary: XP Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing results of its Annual General Meeting held on May 29, 2026, confirming that resolutions set out in the notice of meeting and proxy supplement were duly passed. No special situation is involved—this is a routine meeting outcome report with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other extraordinary corporate event. The filing serves as a standard disclosure of shareholder approval of ordinary business items. No deal terms, premium, or strategic actions are present; thus, no risk-arb angle or event-driven catalyst exists.
